ds2.3.3:11.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti vyañjanaṃ abhilāpo --
ds2.3.3:13.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti vyañjanaṃ abhilāpo --
ds2.3.3:15.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti vyañjanaṃ abhilāpo --
ds2.3.3:17.2: Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho -- asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.3:18.2: Cattāro mahābhūtā catunnañ ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ --
ds2.3.3:19.2: Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ . . . pe . . . avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.3:21.2: Bhavissati attā ca loko cāti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:22.2: Na bhavissati attā ca loko cāti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ --vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:23.2: Sassato attā ca loko cāti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:24.2: Ucchijjissati attā ca loko cāti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:25.2: Antavā attā ca loko cāti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:26.2: Anantavā attā ca loko cāti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:27.2: Pubbantaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:28.2: Aparantaṃ ārabbha yā upajjati diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.3:29.2: Yaṃ na hiriyati hiriyitabbena -- na hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.3.3:30.2: Yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbena -- na ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.3.3:31.2: Yaṃ hiriyati hiriyitabbena -- hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.3.3:32.2: Yaṃ ottappati ottappitabbena -- ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.3.3:33.2: Sahadhammike vuccamāne dovacassatāyaṃ dovacassiyaṃ dovacassatā vippaṭikūlagāhitā vipaccanīkasātatā anādariyaṃ anādaratā agāravatā appaṭissavatā --
ds2.3.3:34.2: Ye te puggalā assaddhā dussīlā appassutā macchārino duppaññā -- yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevaṇā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti sampavaṅkatā --
ds2.3.3:35.2: Sahadhammike vuccamāne sovacassatāyaṃ sovacassiyaṃ sovacassatā appaṭikūlagāhitā avipaccanīkasātatā sagāravatā sappaṭissavatā --
ds2.3.3:36.2: Ye te puggalā saddhā sīlavanto bahussutā cāgavanto paññāvanto -- yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti sampavaṅkatā --
ds2.3.3:37.2: Pañca pi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo, satta pi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo,
ds2.3.3:37.3: yā tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ āpattikusalatā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:38.2: Yā tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā, paññā pajānanā, . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:39.2: Atthi savitakkasavicārā samāpatti, atthi avitakkavicāramattā samāpatti, atthi avitakka-avicārā samāpatti,
ds2.3.3:39.3: yā tāsam samāpattīnaṃ samāpattikusalatā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:40.2: Yā tāhi samāpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:41.2: Aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo -- cakkhudhātu rūpadhātu cakkhuviññāṇadhātu sotadhātu saddadhātu sotaviññaṇadhātu ghānadhātu gandhadhātu ghānaviññāṇadhātu jivhādhātu rasadhātu jivhā viññāṇadhātu kāyadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu kāyaviññāṇadhātu manodhātu dhammadhātu manoviññāṇadhātu
ds2.3.3:41.3: yā tāsaṃ dhātūnaṃ dhātukusalatā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:42.2: Yā tāsaṃ dhātūnaṃ manasikākusalatā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:43.3: cakkhāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ sotāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ, ghāyāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanuṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ, --
ds2.3.3:43.4: yā tesaṃ āyatanānaṃ āyatanakusalatā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:44.2: Avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññaṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ. nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti,
ds2.3.3:44.3: evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotīti,
ds2.3.3:44.4: yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:45.2: Ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ hetu paccayā uppādāya taṃ taṃ ṭhānan ti yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:46.2: Ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ na hetu appaccayā uppādāya taṃ taṃ aṭṭhānan ti yā tattha paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:48.2: Yā mudutā maddavatā akakkhaḷatā -- akaṭhinatā nīcacittatā --
ds2.3.3:49.2: Yā khantī khamanatā adhivāsanatā acaṇḍikkaṃ anasuropo attamanatā cittassa --
ds2.3.3:50.2: Yo kāyiko avītikkamo vācasiko avītikkamo kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo --
ds2.3.3:51.2: Yā sā vācā aṇḍakā asātā kakkasā parakaṭukā parābhisajjanikodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā -- tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ pahāya yā sā vācā neḷā kaṇṇasukhā pemaniyā hadayaṃgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā -- tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti --
ds2.3.3:52.4: idhekacco paṭisanthārako hoti -- āmisapaṭisanthāreṇa vā dhammapaṭisanthārena vā --
ds2.3.3:53.2: Idhekacco puggalo cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anuvyañjanaggāhī,
ds2.3.3:53.3: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundri Yaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharataṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati,
ds2.3.3:53.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anuvyañjanaggāhī,
ds2.3.3:53.9: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
ds2.3.3:53.10: Yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ agutti agopanā anārakkho asaṃvaro --
ds2.3.3:54.2: Idhekacco appaṭisaṅkhā ayoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti, davāya madāya maṇḍanāya vibhūsanāya,
ds2.3.3:54.3: yā tattha asantuṭṭhitā amattaññutā appaṭisaṅkhā bhojane --
ds2.3.3:55.2: Idhekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti na anuvyañjanaggāhi,
ds2.3.3:55.3: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati,
ds2.3.3:55.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhi hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhi,
ds2.3.3:55.9: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati;
ds2.3.3:55.10: yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ gutti gopanā ārakkho saṃvaro --
ds2.3.3:56.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvad eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahma cariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañ ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti;
ds2.3.3:56.4: yā tattha santuṭṭhitā mattaññutā paṭisaṅkhā bhojane --
ds2.3.3:57.2: Yā anussati ananussati appaṭissati, asaraṇata adhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā --
ds2.3.3:58.2: Yam aññāṇaṃ, adassanaṃ . . . pe . . . avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.3:59.2: Yā sati anussati paṭissati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati --
ds2.3.3:60.2: Yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:61.2: Yā paññā-pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi
ds2.3.3:62.2: Yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ --
ds2.3.3:64.2: Yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.3:69.2: Yo kāyiko vītikkamo vācasiko vītikkamo kāyikavācasiko vītikkamo --
ds2.3.3:70.2: Natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paraloko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrahmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchīkatvā pavedentīti,
ds2.3.3:70.3: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigatam . . . pe . . . vipariyesagāho,
ds2.3.3:71.2: Kāyiko avītikkamo vācasiko avītikkamo kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo --
ds2.3.3:72.2: Atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paraloko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchīkatvā pavedentīti
ds2.3.3:72.3: yā evarūpā pāññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi,
ds2.3.3:73.2: Kāyiko avītikkamo vācasiko avītikkamo kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo --
ds2.3.3:74.2: Kammassa kataṃ ñāṇasaccānulomikaṃ ñāṇaṃ maggasa maṅgissa ñāṇaṃ phalasamaṅgissa ñāṇaṃ.
ds2.3.3:75.2: yā paññā pajānanā.. pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.
ds2.3.3:78.2: idha bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati -- uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati -- anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati -- uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
ds2.3.3:79.2: yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya asantuṭṭhassa bhiyyokamyatā.
ds2.3.3:80.2: yā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya sakkaccakiriyatā sātaccakiriyatā aṭṭhitakiriyatā anolīnavuttitā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ.
ds2.3.3:81.3: pubbenivāsānussativiññāṇaṃ vijjā; sattānaṃ cutupapāte ñāṇaṃ vijjā āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ vijjā.
